subject: Kickoff: uniform molecule sampling as a screening data product
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the graph sampler workstream. Screening partners keep asking for unbiased molecule libraries, and "unbiased" is the hard part: you cannot enumerate all molecules at a given size, so everyone samples from generative models with unknown bias. Our sequential importance sampling approach sidesteps that - enumerate stoichiometries for a given heavy-atom count, draw importance-weighted connected graphs per stoichiometry, reject to uniform, then aggregate into one provably uniform sample. Uniformity is the product.

Deliverables this window: pipeline hardened as a service (the enumerate_stoichiometries -> sample_molecules -> reject_to_uniform -> aggregate_uniform_samples chain), a reference library at C,N,O,F with up to 8 heavy atoms, and a scored variant using our property-prediction models.

Milestones: hardened pipeline 4/24, reference library 5/22, scored library + review 6/17.

Saoirse infra, Yara sampling correctness, Wanjiru pipeline. Compute plan from you when ready.

Anders
